scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/runCargoIsolated.ps1 -CargoCommand clippy -Workspace -AllTargets -AllFeatures -DenyWarnings && pnpm i18n:check && pnpm web:build && pnpm desktop:check
